info.title: Cinema Booking System API
info.description: API documentation for Cinema Booking System

put.description:
Requires inventory:write.

The seat must be AVAILABLE and expiresAt must be in the future.
The showtime must be OPEN_FOR_BOOKING and start in the future.
Its room and cinema must both be active.

Returns HTTP 409 with INVENTORY_SHOWTIME_NOT_BOOKABLE
when showtime eligibility is not satisfied.

This endpoint does not reuse an existing HELD seat.

get.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Returns layout metadata, seat snapshots and elements.
This response is for administration.

put.description:
Requires inventory:manage.
Replaces all seats and elements in a DRAFT layout.
Empty arrays clear the corresponding content.
expectedVersion must match the current layout version field.
This operation does not publish or bind the layout to showtimes.

409.description: Layout is not DRAFT or expectedVersion is stale

post.summary: Create a showtime and generate its seats
post.description:
Requires showtime:manage.

roomLayoutId is optional.
When provided, it must identify a PUBLISHED layout of roomId.
Seats are generated from that layout after validating its snapshots.
Active seats start AVAILABLE; inactive seats start UNAVAILABLE.

When omitted, existing active-seat generation is retained.
Seat prices are calculated from basePrice using SeatPricingPolicy.

The layout cannot be changed after creation.

get.summary: Get room layout metadata by room
get.description:
Returns all layout versions, newest first.
Returns an empty array when the room has no layouts.

post.description:
Creates an empty DRAFT layout.
The backend assigns the next layoutVersion for the room.
Canvas dimensions use logical layout units.
This operation does not publish or bind a layout to showtimes.

Requires inventory:manage.
expectedVersion must match the current version field.
Requires at least one seat and one SCREEN.
Validates rotated geometry inside the canvas.
Rejects seat-seat and seat-element overlaps.
Publishes this layout version without binding it to showtimes.

409.description: Layout is not DRAFT or expectedVersion is stale

get.summary: Get the pinned seat map of a showtime
get.description:
Public read API.

Geometry comes from the pinned published layout.
Price and status come from ShowSeat.
Missing ShowSeat yields null showSeatId, price and status,
with selectable=false.

selectable also requires the showtime to be eligible for booking.
HELD seats are not automatically released by this API.

No booking-owner information is returned.
Reading the map does not reserve seats.

409.description: Missing pinned layout, unpublished layout or inconsistent seat map

get.summary: Get bookable showtimes for a cinema
get.description:
Returns future OPEN_FOR_BOOKING showtimes in active rooms
and an active cinema.

The time interval is [from, to).
from and to must include an ISO-8601 offset.
movieId is optional.

OPEN_FOR_BOOKING does not guarantee available seats.

200.description: Matching showtimes, or an empty array

400.description: Invalid query parameters or time range

roomLayoutId.description: Published layout pinned when the showtime was created.

ReplaceRoomLayoutContentRequest.description:
Geometry uses logical layout units.
x and y identify the unrotated top-left corner.
Rotation is around the rectangle center.
Positive rotationDegrees rotate clockwise in screen coordinates.

roomLayoutId.description: Optional published layout belonging to roomId. When omitted, the existing active-seat generation is used.

publishedAt.description: Absent while the layout is a draft

price.description: Price from ShowSeat; null when ShowSeat is missing.

status.description: Stored ShowSeat status; null when ShowSeat is missing.
